limits: the labs run the production adapters on stub engine types; they prove logic and call order, not the game
which colour route each HITNG resource uses was not read from the original file: PARRY_FX event=RESOURCE reports it
if blue lives in the pixels of a colour texture the tint cannot change it; the log reports TEXTURE_BLUE_UNRESOLVED
the two-tick lead comes from native clip data and the log's timing; the real sweep of each cut is not measured
the pressure path (12/35/45%) is not timed against the clip: a parry there needs the shield up in time
